Whilst staying in Coniston I required some antibiotics.
I rang this surgery at 8.15 on a Friday morning ~ I was offered an appointment for 9.40am. I went a few minutes early so they could register me as a visitor. They also have a dispensary so by 10.00 am I was all done ( pills in my hand )
